x: The field for the 3 miles walk was small, but Jack Rutland walked in fine style to overtake all those in front of him, and won easing up in the last lap. Charlie Speechley was a gallant second, with W.

Cope a new member introduced by George Weston, showed his worth by winning the 880 yards in 2 mins. 1.6 secs. Our leading men in the 2 miles race were Archie Bedford, Frank Abberton and Tom Clinton, but W.
